texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Welcome to the application. This is a startup project based on the ABP framework. For more information, visit abp.io.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MaxDurationMustBe: The longest booking allowed must be greater than zero minutes.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MaxHorizonDaysMus: How far ahead people can book must be greater than zero days.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MinLeadMinutesMus: The minimum notice before a booking can't be negative.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:InvalidOwnOverlap: Pick whether people may hold two bookings at once: allow, warn or block.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:TimezoneChangeWit: This building has {count} upcoming bookings, and changing its timezone would move every one of them to a different local time. The timezone can only change while nothing is booked ahead.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MaxSeriesHorizonT: Recurring bookings must be allowed at least as far ahead as single ones ({horizonDays} days).
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:CapacityMustBePos: Capacity must be greater than zero.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:CapacityBelowMinA: Capacity ({capacity}) can't drop below the minimum group size ({minAttendees}) — lower the minimum first.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MinAttendeesMustB: The minimum group size must be greater than zero.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:MinAttendeesExcee: The minimum group size ({minAttendees}) can't exceed this space's capacity ({capacity}).
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:DaysNotNarrower: These operating days aren't fully covered by the parent level's operating days.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:HoursNotNarrower: These operating hours aren't fully covered by the parent level's operating hours.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:OverrideEndsAtMus: A closure's end time must be after its start time.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:ReasonDetailTooLo: The closure's reason detail is too long.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:SpaceTypeNameAlre: A space type named '{name}' already exists.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:SpaceTypeInUse: This space type is still assigned to one or more spaces and can't be deleted.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:SpaceTypeNameAlre: Another space type was just given one of these names. Check the names and save again.
texts.Dixels:Localization:DefaultLanguageNameR: Enter a name in {language} — it's shown in every language that has no name of its own.
texts.Dixels:Localization:UnsupportedLanguage: '{language}' isn't one of this app's languages.
texts.Dixels:Localization:LanguageListedTwice: {language} is listed twice. Keep one name per language.
texts.Dixels:SpaceManagement:ParentIsDeleted: This can't be restored while the {parent} it belongs to is deleted. Restore the {parent} first.
texts.Dixels:Users:InvalidBuildingId: The building id is not valid. Pick a building from the list.
texts.Dixels:TooManyRequests: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:NotAligned: Bookings start and end on {slotMinutes}-minute boundaries — pick times like 09:00, 09:15 or 09:30.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SpaceClosed: This space is closed from {from} to {until} ({level} closure: {reason}). Pick another time or another space.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:OverCapacity: This space seats {capacity}, but you asked for {attendees}. Reduce the attendees or pick a larger space.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:BelowMinAttendees: This space needs at least {minAttendees} attendees ({level} rule), but you asked for {attendees}. Add attendees or pick a smaller space.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:TooLong: Bookings here can last at most {maxDuration} ({level} rule), but you asked for {requested}. Shorten the booking.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:ClosedDay: This space isn't open on {day} ({level} rule — open {openDays}). Pick another day.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:OutsideHours: This booking falls outside opening hours, {hours} ({level} rule). Move it inside those hours.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:BeyondHorizon: Bookings can be made up to {horizonDays} days ahead — the latest date is {lastDate}. Pick an earlier date.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:StartInPast: That start time has already passed. Pick a time in the future.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:TooSoon: Bookings need at least {leadMinutes} minutes' notice. Pick a later start time.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:Overlap: This space is already booked for part of that time. Pick another time or another space.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:NotAligned:Short: Times must be on the {slotMinutes}-minute grid
texts.Dixels:Bookings:InvalidTimeRange: The end time must be after the start time.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:AttendeesMustBePositive: A booking needs at least one attendee.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:NotAssignedToBuilding: You can only book spaces in your assigned building. Ask an administrator to assign you to this building.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:IdempotencyKeyReused: This request was already submitted with different details. Refresh the page and try again.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:NotCancellable: This booking can't be cancelled because it is already {status}.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:NotYours: You can only cancel your own bookings.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:AlreadyStarted: This booking has already started, so it can't be cancelled.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:InvalidDateRange: Pick a date range of 1 to {maxDays} days, with the end after the start.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:OwnOverlap: You already have {spaceName} booked {from}–{until}, and this building allows one booking at a time. Cancel that booking or pick another time.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesInvalidRule: That repeat pattern isn't valid. Pick daily, weekly or monthly.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesNoWeekdays: Pick at least one day of the week to repeat on.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesEndBeforeStart: The end date must be on or after the first booking.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesTooManyOccurrences: A series can have at most {max} bookings. Pick an earlier end date or repeat less often.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesBeyondHorizon: Recurring bookings can run up to {horizonDays} days ahead — the latest end date is {lastDate}.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesNothingToBook: Every date is unticked, so there's nothing to book.
texts.Dixels:Bookings:SeriesDateUnavailable: {date} was just taken or no longer fits the rules, so nothing was booked. Check the dates again and book the rest.
texts.Language:Label: Language
texts.SignIn:Tagline: Find a desk, a focus pod or a meeting room across every building — and know it is really yours.
texts.SignIn:PointRecurring: Single and recurring bookings, validated one occurrence at a time
texts.SignIn:PointTimezone: Every time shown in the building's own timezone
texts.SignIn:PointNoDoubleBooking: No double bookings — a slot is yours the moment it commits
texts.SignIn:Title: Sign in
texts.SignIn:Subtitle: Use your Email to continue.
texts.SignIn:Foot: You'll be taken to your organization's sign-in page. Nothing is typed here.
texts.Auth:RedirectingComeBack: You'll come straight back here afterwards.
texts.Auth:TakingYouHome: Taking you to your home page…
texts.Auth:RefusedTitle: Signed in, but the server keeps refusing
texts.Auth:RefusedDetail: Your sign-in works, yet every request is answered with “not authorized”. Signing in again won't change that — it usually means the app and the API are configured for different servers. Tell an administrator; you can retry once that's fixed.
texts.Access:NothingSetUpTitle: Nothing's been set up for your account yet
texts.Access:NothingSetUpDetail: You're signed in, but you haven't been given access to any page. Ask an administrator to set up your access.
texts.Access:DeniedTitle: You don't have access to this page
texts.Access:DeniedDetail: Ask an administrator if you think you should.
texts.Error:Network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection, or that the backend is running, and try again.
texts.Error:PermissionDenied: You don't have permission to do this. Ask an administrator if you think you should.
texts.Error:BoundaryDetail: This part of the page hit an error it couldn't recover from. Reloading usually fixes it; if it keeps happening, tell an administrator what you were doing.
texts.Pagination:Label: Pagination
texts.Timezone:Label: Timezone
texts.Error:Generic: Something went wrong — please try again.
texts.Names:DefaultRequired: A name in {language} is required — it shows in every language without its own.
texts.SpaceTypes:Title: Space types
texts.SpaceTypes:Lead: Shared across every building — renaming or re-icon-ing a type updates it everywhere it's used.
texts.SpaceTypes:NoMatch: No space types match the search.
texts.SpaceTypes:Empty: No space types yet — add one to get started.
texts.SpaceTypes:DeleteDetail: This can't be undone. A type that's still assigned to spaces can't be deleted.
texts.SpaceTypes:FormDetail: Shared across every building — changes show everywhere the type is used.
texts.Calendar:Title: My calendar
texts.Calendar:BuildingLoadFailed: Couldn't load your building — please refresh.
texts.Calendar:NoBuilding: You haven't been assigned to a building yet, so there's nothing to show.
texts.Calendar:NoBuildingDetail: Ask an administrator to assign you to your building.
texts.Calendar:BookingsLoadFailed: Couldn't load your bookings — please try again.
texts.Calendar:BookingLoadFailed: Couldn't load this booking — please try again.
texts.Calendar:CancelledSeries_one: Cancelled {count} booking of “{title}” — {space} is free again then
texts.Calendar:CancelledSeries_other: Cancelled {count} bookings of “{title}” — {space} is free again then
texts.Calendar:TooSoon: Too soon: bookings need {notice} notice. The earliest you can start today is {time}.
texts.Calendar:CappedAt: Capped at {duration}, the longest any room allows.
texts.Calendar:CappedAtSome: Capped at {duration}, the longest any room allows — {fit} of {total} rooms.
texts.Booking:CancelledByAdminDetail: An administrator cancelled this booking. The room is no longer held for you; pick another time or room.
texts.Booking:CancelledByAdminWithReason: An administrator cancelled this booking — {reason}. The room is no longer held for you; pick another time or room.
texts.Booking:AlreadyStarted: This booking has already started, so it can't be cancelled.
texts.Booking:CancelFailed: Couldn't cancel the booking — please try again.
texts.Booking:CancelSummary: {space}, {date} {start}–{end}. The room is released straight away, so someone else can book it.
texts.Booking:CancelOnlyUpcoming: Only upcoming ones are cancelled — past ones stay in your history.
texts.QuickBook:CheckFailed: Couldn't check the rooms — please try again.
texts.QuickBook:NoneFree: No room is free for this time
texts.QuickBook:OthersUnavailable_one: {count} other room can't take this time
texts.QuickBook:OthersUnavailable_other: {count} other rooms can't take this time
texts.QuickBook:AllowUpTo: They allow up to {max} — this is {length}.
texts.Hierarchy:Title: Space management
texts.Hierarchy:BuildingsLead: Open a building to manage its floors and spaces.
texts.Hierarchy:FloorsLead: Open a floor to manage its spaces.
texts.Hierarchy:NoBuildings: No buildings yet — add one to get started.
texts.Hierarchy:NoFloors: No floors yet — add one to get started.
texts.Hierarchy:NoSpaces: No spaces yet — add one to get started.
texts.Hierarchy:DeleteBuildingConfirm: Delete "{name}"? This also deletes its floors and spaces — they can all be restored together later.
texts.Hierarchy:DeleteFloorConfirm: Delete "{name}"? This also deletes its spaces — they can all be restored together later.
texts.Hierarchy:Name: Name
texts.Hierarchy:FloorNumberWhole: Floor number must be a whole number.
texts.Hierarchy:CapacityPositive: Capacity must be a positive number.
texts.Hierarchy:EditDetailsDetail: Rules and hours are edited on the constraints page; this is what it's called and where it is.
texts.Hierarchy:MoreKeepTyping: {more} more — keep typing to narrow down.
texts.Hierarchy:ImpactClosureTitle_one: This closure falls on {count} upcoming booking
texts.Hierarchy:ImpactClosureTitle_other: This closure falls on {count} upcoming bookings
texts.Hierarchy:ImpactDeleteDetail: They'll be cancelled, and whoever booked them will see why on their calendar. Restoring later won't bring them back.
texts.Hierarchy:ImpactReassignDetail: They can only book in one building, so their bookings in the current one are cancelled. They'll see why on their calendar.
texts.Hierarchy:ImpactChangeDetail: They were booked under the current rules. Keep them as they are, or cancel them — whoever booked them will see why on their calendar.
texts.Hierarchy:ImpactAssignedDetail: They won't be able to book until you assign them to another building — or restore this one.
texts.Hierarchy:KeepAndAddClosure: Keep them and add the closure
texts.Users:Title: Users
texts.Users:LeadAssign: Choose the single building each of them books in — they never see any other.
texts.Users:LeadReadOnly: The building each of them books in. Your account can view these but not change them.
texts.Users:Search: Search by name, username or email…
texts.Users:NoMatch: No one matches the current search and filters.
texts.Users:AssignedCancelled_one: {name} assigned to a building · {count} booking cancelled.
texts.Users:AssignedCancelled_other: {name} assigned to a building · {count} bookings cancelled.
texts.App:DeniedMyCalendarTitle: You don't have access to My calendar
texts.App:DeniedMyCalendarDetail: Your account doesn't have permission to view bookings. Ask an administrator if you think it should.
texts.App:DeniedFindSpaceDetail: Your account doesn't have permission to create bookings. Ask an administrator if you think it should.
texts.App:DeniedHierarchyTitle: You don't have access to the hierarchy
texts.App:DeniedHierarchyDetail: Viewing buildings, floors or spaces is needed to open it. Ask an administrator to add Buildings, Floors or Spaces to your role.
texts.App:DeniedFloorsTitle: You can't see this building's floors
texts.App:DeniedFloorsDetail: Viewing floors (or the spaces on them) is needed to open this page. Ask an administrator to add Floors or Spaces to your role.
texts.App:DeniedSpacesTitle: You can't see this floor's spaces
texts.App:DeniedSpacesDetail: Viewing spaces is needed to open this page. Ask an administrator to add Spaces to your role.
texts.App:DeniedSpaceTypesDetail: Viewing space types is needed to open this page. Ask an administrator to add Space types to your role.
texts.App:DeniedUsersDetail: Viewing users is needed to open this page. Ask an administrator to add Identity management → User management to your role.
texts.App:DeniedRulesDetailBuilding: Viewing buildings is needed to open its rules. Ask an administrator to add it to your role.
texts.App:DeniedRulesDetailFloor: Viewing floors is needed to open its rules. Ask an administrator to add it to your role.
texts.App:DeniedRulesDetailSpace: Viewing spaces is needed to open its rules. Ask an administrator to add it to your role.
texts.App:DeniedRulesDetailOther: Viewing this level is needed to open its rules. Ask an administrator to add it to your role.
texts.Rules:Title: Constraints
texts.Rules:LeadBuilding: Building level — only this level's own rules are set here.
texts.Rules:LeadFloor: Floor level · {building} — only this level's own rules are set here. Anything left on Inherit follows the level above.
texts.Rules:LeadSpace: Space level · {floor} · {building} — only this level's own rules are set here. Anything left on Inherit follows the level above.
texts.Rules:ViewOnly: View only — your account can't change these rules. Ask an administrator if you think it should.
texts.Rules:Grandfathered: Tightening a constraint never cancels existing bookings — confirmed bookings are grandfathered.
texts.Rules:ChangedElsewhere: Someone else changed this since you loaded it — reloading the latest version.
texts.Rules:DiscardDetail: The rules you changed here haven't been saved.
texts.Rules:WhatAppliesHint: The resolved value, and which level decided it
texts.Rules:SeriesHorizonHint: How far ahead the last date of a repeating booking may be.
texts.Rules:SeriesHorizonTooShort: Must be at least the booking horizon ({days}).
texts.Rules:OverlapAllowHint: People can hold several bookings at once (a desk and a meeting room) without being told.
texts.Rules:OverlapWarnHint: People can hold several bookings at once, but are told about the clash before they book.
texts.Rules:OverlapBlockHint: A second booking that overlaps one someone already has is refused.
texts.Rules:NoMinimumNote: No minimum — any group size can book. The capacity is still enforced as the maximum.
texts.Rules:MinAboveCapacity: Invalid: a minimum above the {capacity}-seat capacity makes this space unbookable.
texts.Rules:MinAttendeesNote_one: Rejects bookings for fewer than {count} attendee.
texts.Rules:MinAttendeesNote_other: Rejects bookings for fewer than {count} attendees.
texts.Rules:BaseLayer: Base layer — every value is required
texts.Rules:ResetTitle: Reset every field on this level to Inherit?
texts.Rules:ResetDetail: This discards all of this level's own overrides. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
texts.Rules:NoLongerFitsDays: {name} no longer fits inside the new operating days
texts.Rules:NoLongerFitsHours: {name} no longer fits inside the new operating hours
texts.Rules:RemoveClosureDetail: The space becomes bookable again for that time.
texts.Booking:BuildingRemovedDetail: An administrator removed it, and your upcoming bookings there were cancelled. You can still see them on <calendar>My calendar</calendar>. Ask an administrator to assign you to another building.
texts.Booking:BuildingRemovedDetailCalendar: An administrator removed it, and your upcoming bookings there were cancelled — they are shown struck through below. Ask an administrator to assign you to another building.
texts.Repeat:Label: Repeat
texts.BookingForm:Title: Book {space}
texts.BookingForm:AttendeesRequired: Enter how many people are coming.
texts.BookingForm:TimesNote: Times are in {timezone} ({building}'s local time). You can book up to {date}.
texts.BookingForm:AvailabilityCheckFailed: Couldn't check availability — please try again.
texts.BookingForm:DatesCheckFailed: Couldn't check the dates — please try again.
texts.BookingForm:AppliesToEveryDate: This applies to every date, so none can be booked until it's fixed.
texts.FindSpace:NoBuilding: You haven't been assigned to a building yet, so there's nothing to book.
texts.FindSpace:Lead_one: {building} · times in {timezone} · book up to {count} days ahead
texts.FindSpace:Lead_other: {building} · times in {timezone} · book up to {count} days ahead
texts.FindSpace:AvailabilityOnly: Availability only: your account can't make bookings.
texts.FindSpace:TryAnotherTime: Try another time — or drag on a room's bar below to book any free time it has.
texts.FindSpace:BookOrDrag: Book for this time, or drag on a room's bar to pick a different time.
texts.FindSpace:FreeRestOfDay: Free the rest of the day
texts.FindSpace:DayBarPick: {label}. Pick a time for {space}: drag across free time, or use the arrow keys and Enter.
